instruction.text: Emma and her friends can make four 300 ml bottles of lemonade in one minute. How many litres of lemonade can they make per hour?
instruction.sound: Emma and her friends can make four three hundred millilitre bottles of lemonade in one minute. How many litres of lemonade can they make per hour?

atoms.a: First, calculate the total amount of lemon juice produced per minute in millilitres.

instruction.text: Now, calculate the total amount of lemon juice produced per hour in litres

atoms.b: Emma and her friends can make <mat><gap>72</gap></mat> litres of lemonade per hour.

instruction.text: A zookeeper has calculated that the monkeys in the zoo eat 70 bananas each week. Each banana weighs 120 grams. How many kilograms of bananas do the monkeys eat each day?

atoms.a: First, calculate the total mass of bananas eaten each week in grams.
atoms.sound: First, calculate the total mass of bananas eaten each week in grams.

atoms.a: Next, calculate the total mass of bananas eaten each day in grams.
atoms.sound: Next, calculate the total mass of bananas eaten each day in grams.

instruction.text: On the school bus one morning, Rohit noticed that in 5 minutes the bus had travelled a distance of 2,500 metres. At what speed in kilometres per hour is the bus travelling at?

atoms.a: First, calculate the speed of the bus in metres per minute (m/min).
atoms.sound: First, calculate the speed of the bus in metres per minute.

atoms.a: Next, calculate the speed of the bus in metres per hour (m/h).
atoms.sound: Next, calculate the speed of the bus in metres per hour.

atoms.a: Now, convert your answer into kilometres per hour (km/h).
atoms.sound: Now, convert your answer into kilometres per hour.

instruction.text: Alisha timed her dad on his motorcycle and measured that he travelled 20,000 metres in 15 minutes. What speed did Alisha’s dad travel at in miles per hour?

atoms.a: First, calculate the speed of the motorcycle in metres per hour (m/h).

atoms.a: Next, convert the speed into kilometres per hour (km/h).
